thread:
maria_cs: kickoff: Verdant Health Dedicated capacity gating + probe plan. customer wants guaranteed 400 qps steady, 1800 qps 3m bursts, and a 20m sustained peak once/day. need quota stamp, autoscale config, and a 2-hr smoke + 30m canary window. adding checklist below.

lee_eng: noted. model profile is rw-small-4k for most, but they have occasional long-form answers up to 2k tokens. we'll prepare fp16 + int8 fallback.

omar_sre: proposed autoscale: target_util=65%, scale_up at 70% (sustained 90s), scale_down at 35% (sustained 4m). max_nodes = quota_nodes. set cooldowns: up=2m, down=6m. enable headroom cushion 15% for GC spikes.

kiran_devex: loadgen config I'll run from shared harness. snippet:```
load_profile:
  baseline: {rps: 400, duration: 30m}
  daily_peak: {rps: 1800, duration: 3m}
  endurance: {rps: 600, duration: 20m}
concurrency: 80
headers: {Authorization: "Bearer $LG_TOKEN"}
```

kiran_devex: will also do prefix priming for common KV keys and run 10k lightweight priming requests.

amy_billing: billing-side: quoted reserved capacity committed. invoice anchor set. renewal risk: low but note they requested custom billing cadence, flagged in account (CS-4004).

maria_cs: security note from Verdant: must provide KMS ARN and cross-account key policy. KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:888812345678:key/verdant-key. omar, can you validate no public S3 egress during tests?

omar_sre: yep. I'll validate IAM role mapping and egress rules. will run network checklist before provisioning.

infra-bot: reserved-pool created: rp-verdant-01 id=rp-7d4c9a. region=us-west-2.

lee_eng: warmup plan: "kv-prime.sh" will run 15m before canary, priming hot prefixes and preloading embeddings cache. posting gist in channel in a sec.

kiran_devex: timeline proposal: 
- Tue 2024-09-03 14:00 UTC: security + billing handoff (amy + maria)
- Wed 2024-09-04 03:00 UTC: infra provision slot
- Wed 2024-09-04 05:00 UTC: warmup + priming (eng)
- Wed 2024-09-04 07:00 UTC: smoke + 30m canary -> progressive ramp to full traffic

maria_cs: please capture all Verdant feedback in ticket CS-4004 and add notes to onboarding doc https://redwood-internal/onboard/verdant. we'll have a 30m enablement session after cutover for app owners.

omar_sre: tracing hooks: ensure x-rw-request-id and x-client-id are propagated. I'll attach tracing dashboard and mute noisy alerts for the ramp window.

lee_eng: fallback model config: int8-fast as fallback with cost cap. will add automatic fallback policy: if p95 latency > 450ms for >2m AND error_rate < 1% then route to int8 variant.

amy_billing: acked billing items. once infra confirms pool size I'll finalize the reserved invoice.

kiran_devex: loadgen will push metrics to s3://redwood-loads/verdant/2024-09-04 for postmortem. will also upload sample prompts and seed corpus.

maria_cs: quick ask to team: react :thumbsup: once your action items are done. also flag if timeline needs shifting.

omar_sre: :thumbsup: doing pre-provision network tests tomorrow.

lee_eng: :thumbsup: gist posted: https://gist.internal/lee/verdant-kv-prime (contains runbook + curl loops).

amy_billing: :thumbsup: billing anchor set.

kiran_devex: :thumbsup: load harness ready, dry-run Sat 12:00 UTC.

maria_cs: great. closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers. we'll schedule retro 24h after cutover to capture customer enablement feedback and renewal notes.
